---
title: "Manuscript: MPX NYC Intervention Strategy"
---



```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| label: fig-radargroupsex
#| fig-cap: "MPX NYC (2022): Social or Sexual Contact in Group Setting over Past 4 Weeks"
#| 




  targets::tar_read(participant_data) %>%
    mutate(groupSex = factor(groupSex, c("no", "yes"), c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
    group_by(groupSex) %>%
    summarize(count = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(groupSex)) %>%
    mutate(level = groupSex) %>%
    mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot() + 
        ggplot2::geom_bar(aes(x = level, fill = level, y = proportion), width = 1, stat = "identity") + 
        ggplot2::theme_void() + 
        ggplot2::theme(
                        legend.position = "none", 
                        panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(size = 0.1),
                        axis.text.x = element_text(),
                        axis.text.y = element_text()
                        ) + 
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(
                                              mpxnyc_colors$dark_blue, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$dark_pink, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$dark_purple, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_blue, mpxnyc_colors$light_pink, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_purple)
          ) + 
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2, "cm"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    ) + 
    labs(
          title = "Social or sexual contact in group setting over prior 4 weeks",
          subtitle = "MPX NYC, New York, 2022",
          caption = "Data source: MPX NYC 2022")
  

```
